messages.subject: Project Yarrow — updated pricing model with final terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Grace,

Attached is the updated pricing model reflecting the final negotiated terms (5% escalation cap, carbon-fibre pass-through, 2% volume rebate above 90 ship-sets). The un-escalated aggregate ties to the £148.4m indicative in clause 8.2; the escalated mid-case comes out around £168m over the term as upside. No formula errors.

This supports the board paper for Friday's meeting.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
